title: The Ghost Train at Luna Park
victim: Leo Marchetti, owner of the ride
teaser: The ghost train carried guests all Halloween evening, and nobody was surprised by the motionless figure in the last car. Only at closing time did people realise it was Leo Marchetti, the ride's owner, and next to him sat the skeleton from the tunnel, holding his ticket punched at number 13 in its bony hand. Twice that evening the train stopped in the dark, and nobody admits to touching the switch.

habits.label: Skeleton gloves
habits.habit: Black gloves with white bones painted on them
clues: Under the chair by the control booth lies a single black glove with finger bones painted on in white. The culprit wears gloves with a painted skeleton.
A boy at the shooting gallery remembered a black hand with white bones that put a token on the counter and never picked up the rifle. The culprit has black gloves with bones on them.

habits.label: Candyfloss
habits.habit: Has carried a stick of pink candyfloss all evening
clues: Pink strands of candyfloss are stuck to the seat of the last car in the tunnel, and Marchetti never touched sweets. The culprit has carried candyfloss all evening.
A girl in the queue for the Ferris wheel complained that someone squeezing past got pink candyfloss on her coat. The culprit has been eating candyfloss all evening.

habits.label: Confetti down the collar
habits.habit: Orange confetti stuck in their collar
clues: Orange circles of confetti are scattered on the black velvet tablecloth in the fortune teller's tent. The culprit has confetti in their collar.
Orange confetti is stuck to the oily floor of the mechanics' workshop, and the party poppers were only fired on the main walk. The culprit has orange confetti down their collar.

habits.label: Devil horns
habits.habit: Red cardboard devil horns on a headband
clues: A little girl with a balloon at the entrance ticket booth remembered someone wearing red devil horns. The culprit wears devil horns.
In the mechanics' workshop a broken wire headband with a bit of red cardboard hangs on a hook. The culprit has red horns on a headband.

habits.label: Tokens in the pocket
habits.habit: A pocket jingling with the park's brass tokens
clues: Under the seat of the last car in the tunnel there are two brass tokens, and the ride's owner rode for free. The culprit has a pocket full of tokens.
Three tokens are scattered on the step of the control booth, though nobody pays for the controls with tokens. The culprit carries park tokens in their pocket.

habits.label: Teddy bear
habits.habit: Carries a teddy bear from the shooting gallery under their arm
clues: In the fortune teller's tent there's a tuft of brown plush and a torn-off button eye on the clients' chair. The culprit carries a teddy bear around.
A sailor on shore leave saw from the Ferris wheel someone making for the tunnel with a huge bear under their arm. The culprit carries a teddy bear under their arm.

habits.label: Grease under the nails
habits.habit: Black machine grease under their nails
clues: The ticket in the skeleton's hand in the tunnel is smudged by black fingers: it's machine grease. The culprit has grease under their nails.
In the entrance ticket booth a roll of clean tickets has a greasy black print, and the counter here is wiped every hour. The culprit has machine grease under their nails.

habits.label: Hawaiian shirt
habits.habit: A loud Hawaiian shirt with palm trees
clues: A scrap of cotton print with yellow palm trees is caught on a bolt in a Ferris wheel car. The culprit has a Hawaiian shirt.
A tipsy reveller by the mechanics' workshop door saw a loud shirt with palm trees in the dark. The culprit wears a Hawaiian shirt.

habits.label: Toothpick in the mouth
clues: A chewed wooden toothpick lies by the switch on the control booth. The culprit chews a toothpick.
Under the counter in the shooting gallery there are two toothpicks chewed flat to fibres. The culprit is always chewing a toothpick.

habits.label: Earring
habits.habit: A small gold ring in their earlobe
clues: A tiny gold ring with a clasp, the kind worn in an earlobe, glinted between the sleepers in the tunnel. The culprit has a ring earring.
The newspaper seller at the entrance ticket booth remembered only a gold ring in the ear of the person who asked when the ghost train closes. The culprit has a gold earring.

habits.label: Broken nose
habits.habit: A nose knocked crooked in the ring
clues: A soldier on leave at the shooting gallery made out in the lamplight a profile with a nose bent to one side. The culprit has a broken nose.
A couple on a bench by the control booth saw a face with a flattened nose, like a boxer's, on the little stairway. The culprit's nose is broken like a boxer's.

habits.label: Harmonica
habits.habit: A harmonica in their breast pocket
clues: A shooter at the gallery complained that someone behind him kept drawing out the same note on a harmonica. The culprit plays the harmonica.
A brass reed from a harmonica lies on the ledge of the entrance ticket booth window. The culprit has a harmonica in their pocket.

habits.label: Smells of fish
habits.habit: Their clothes smell of fish from the pier
clues: In the last car in the tunnel, raw fish cuts through the smell of paint and grease. The culprit smells of fish.
The flap of the fortune teller's tent smells of fish, though only incense sticks are burned inside. The culprit smells of fish from the pier.

habits.label: Red braces
clues: In the mechanics' workshop a torn-off clip with a scrap of red elastic from a pair of braces lies by the workbench. The culprit wears red braces.
An elderly lady in the Ferris wheel queue remembered bright red braces under an open jacket. The culprit wears bright red braces.

habits.label: Italian words
habits.habit: Drops Italian words into their speech
clues: Behind the flap of the fortune teller's tent someone was arguing in a low voice and kept repeating "basta" and "madonna". The culprit drops Italian words into their speech.
Schoolchildren in the queue at the entrance ticket booth heard someone mutter "mamma mia" while looking at the clock. The culprit slips Italian words into their speech.

habits.label: Sheet costume
habits.habit: Wears a ghost sheet with eyeholes over their shoulders
clues: In the shooting gallery a scrap of white sheet with the hemmed edge of an eyehole hangs on a nail by the back door. The culprit goes about in a ghost costume made from a sheet.
In the mechanics' workshop a white sheet with two eyeholes, hastily folded, was thrown on a box of bolts. The culprit has a ghost sheet with eyeholes.

tech: On the control booth the stop relay was bridged with wire, and the "Train stopped" lamp didn't light once all evening. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The mechanical ghost on a cable in the tunnel was switched to manual and hung over the last car at exactly the right minute. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
tools: The emergency exit grille in the tunnel was unscrewed and put back, every nut tightened. The culprit is handy with tools.
A brake shoe on the Ferris wheel was taken apart and reassembled, and the cars stopped for three minutes. The culprit is handy with tools.
cash: In the entrance ticket booth a bundle of ghost train tickets has been punched, but the money for them isn't in the drawer. The culprit had access to money.
The envelope with the evening's takings is missing from Marchetti's pocket, and the change is stacked beside him in neat columns, the way it's counted at the till. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The safe in the control booth was opened without a single scratch, and Marchetti's debt book is missing from it. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The fireproof box in the entrance ticket booth is locked on its combination, yet the workers' IOUs have vanished from it. The culprit knows the safe combination.
keys: The punch used to clip the ticket at number 13 is kept in a locked drawer at the tunnel entrance, and the lock was opened with a key. The culprit had keys.
The mechanics' workshop is locked at eight, yet at half past nine its door stood open, the lock without a single scratch. The culprit had keys.
quiet: The gravel crunches underfoot in the tunnel, yet the couple in the next-to-last car didn't hear a step. The culprit moves silently.
A string of bells hangs at the flap of the fortune teller's tent and jingles at any touch, yet someone left the tent without a sound. The culprit moves silently.
passages: A crawlway under the graveyard scenery, unknown to visitors, leads from the tunnel to the control booth, and the cobwebs in it are torn. The culprit knows the service passages.
Behind the shooting gallery there's a gate into a passage along the fence right to the mechanics' workshop, and the dust on its bolt has been rubbed off. The culprit knows the service passages.
sched: The train stopped the second time at the very minute the ticket roll is changed on schedule and the tunnel entrance empties. The culprit knows the schedule.
Security checks the tunnel at the start of every hour, and it was all over ten minutes before the round. The culprit knows the schedule.
strong: Next to Marchetti in the last car in the tunnel sits a skeleton on a cast-iron frame that the mechanics lift off its hook in pairs. The culprit is physically strong.
In the shooting gallery the prize crate that takes two to move has been pushed away from the back door, and there are footprints of only one person beside it. The culprit is physically strong.
driver: The prize lorry was driven from the mechanics' workshop to the back gates, and its engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
The tractor used to tow cars for repair was abandoned by the entrance ticket booth with the key in the ignition, though during the day it stood in the depot. The culprit can drive.
french: "C'est fini, Léo", French for "It's over, Leo", is written on the back of the Death card left on the table in the fortune teller's tent. The culprit knows French.
On the ticket in the tunnel skeleton's hand someone has pencilled "treize, comme promis", French for "thirteen, as promised". The culprit knows French.
